method: Declared analysis of documents/records/qwen9b/a6000-controls-design.md over the 57 dev tasks of both controls studies, with reference arms from the cohort's reference and confirmation studies: paired task bootstrap and family intervals (10,000 draws), family resampling p-values and a Holm adjustment across C1 to C6. The 38-task and 19-task parts are descriptive, as declared. Required-API coverage and openings were not declared. Execution fields describe the second controls study; the first is in a6000-dev19-controls.json. Offline only.
